3605-4808-5131-5241.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying {2}{U}{U}, causing it to enter as a Ninja copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

500-4477-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-4477-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Greenwarden of Murasa and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa tokens enter, they each trigger, returning Cabal Ritual and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3525-3755-8230.easyPrerequisites: Seedship Agrarian doesn't have summoning sickness.
3525-3755-8230.description:
Activate Seedship Agrarian by tapping it, adding {U}.
Seedship Agrarian triggers, creating a Lander token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Seedship Agrarian.
Repeat.

1021-4693-6303-6763.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

4881-6618-6909.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6618-6909.description:
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1284-4687-5115.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least four counters on it.
1284-4687-5115.description:
Activate Viridian Longbow by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

81-2021-2060-6627.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

5256-6490-7487--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Zealous Lorecaster.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
5256-6490-7487--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Zealous Lorecaster, causing you to mill cards equal to Zealous Lorecaster's power.
Cast Zealous Lorecaster from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5231-6553-7424.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

2921-3497-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
2921-3497-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

1336-7282-7340.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat.

2292-7084-7201.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

104-4772-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-4772-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

573-5702-6763-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-5702-6763-6850.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

3358-4881-5295.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1722-1808-4050-6625.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

3603-4477-5195.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Greenwarden of Murasa
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1018-2080-4050.notablePrerequisites: The number of nontoken creatures you control plus the number of creature cards in all graveyards is at least nine.
1018-2080-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Skullwinder, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each other nontoken creature you control.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, returning all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rise of the Dark Realms to your hand from your graveyard and causing an opponent to return a card to their hand from their graveyard.
Repeat.

246-3054-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
246-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Poxwalkers and Oathsworn Vampire, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Poxwalkers triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2847-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Armada Wurm, adding {C}{C}.
Armada Wurm dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Armada Wurm from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Armada Wurm enters the battlefield, creating a 5/5 Wurm creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Wurm, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1812-1912-2005.notablePrerequisites: Jetfire has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1812-1912-2005.description:
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} and converting it.
Cult of the Waxing Moon triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Activate Prismite three times by paying {3}, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {U}{U}{U}, converting it and putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Cult of the Waxing Moon triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Repeat.

403-1355.notablePrerequisites:
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five enchantments.
403-1355.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Thassa's Ire by paying {3}{U}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

614-1964-1987-2510.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
614-1964-1987-2510.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

958-1750-2575-5261.description:
Cast Temporal Mastery by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Temporal Mastery.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Temporal Mastery into your graveyard from exile.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dralnu by tapping it, giving Temporal Mastery flashback until end of turn.
Cast Temporal Mastery from your graveyard by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Temporal Mastery.
Repeat from step 2.
